diagnostics.summary: the type of `parts` cannot be inferred.
diagnostics.label: uninferable binding type
causes: A bare `Ok(...)`, `Err(...)`, `None`, or `[]` leaves a type parameter open, and this binding is never used, so nothing can constrain it — the type is ambiguous and would not lower to valid Rust.

fixes.title: Add a type annotation (e.g. `let v: Result<Int, String> = ...`, `let xs: List<Int> = []`) or remove the unused binding.

diagnostics.summary: arithmetic operators are only built in for numeric values.
diagnostics.label: operator on non-numeric value
causes: RSScript does not support user-defined operator overloads.

fixes.title: Use a named function such as `Type.add(left: read a, right: read b)`.
